title: Zechariah
description: Post-exilic prophetic book of the Hebrew Bible, partly attributed to the late-6th-century prophet Zechariah (chs 1–8) and partly to a later anonymous voice (chs 9–14). Cited in the corpus principally for Zechariah 3 (the high-priest vision with the satan figure as accuser) and the eschatological visions of the later chapters.
